releases.name: opencode-muse 0.1.1
releases.body:
## opencode-muse 0.1.1

Patch release carrying state-path hardening and a provider-list smoke portability fix.

### Fixed

- **Hardened the plugin state-directory guard:** configured state paths are now canonicalized through existing symlinks before being accepted, so a symlink into the Muse CLI's configuration directory is rejected instead of receiving plugin state. Includes regression tests for real, dangling, and benign symlinks. See commit [`c8e8f42`](https://github.com/pgquiles/opencode-muse/commit/c8e8f42ce11b4412d4ae69b1ba2d24f23236e86b).
- **CI portability:** the provider-list smoke probe no longer assumes `/tmp/opencode` exists, fixing the Test-step failure in the v0.1.0 release workflow. See commit [`3272b90`](https://github.com/pgquiles/opencode-muse/commit/3272b9013a76486e56a2379c044b906dc02c78a1).

### Compatibility and known issue

- The published config-array package entry loaded and listed Muse models on OpenCode 2.1.3; standalone Spark 1.2 and Spark 1.3 text turns completed through Muse CLI 1.4.12.
- **Known issue #25:** in a shared, long-lived OpenCode service, a completed turn may leave its workspace lock and active-turn markers behind, preventing another request in that workspace. This was reproduced through the CLI using the shared service; OpenChamber's UI-level model-switch path has not yet been independently verified. Use a standalone/private server as a workaround while this is investigated.

### Install

Add `opencode-muse@0.1.1` to the `plugins` array in `opencode.jsonc`, then sign in with `muse login`. See the [README](https://github.com/pgquiles/opencode-muse#installation).

Package: [opencode-muse@0.1.1 on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-muse/v/0.1.1)

releases.name: opencode-muse 0.1.0
releases.body:
## opencode-muse 0.1.0

Initial public release of the OpenCode plugin that connects to Muse Code through the official Muse CLI and session protocol. Muse sign-in and inference remain in the CLI; the plugin does not extract or store subscription credentials.

### Install

Add `opencode-muse@0.1.0` to the `plugins` array in `opencode.jsonc`, then sign in with `muse login`. See the [README](https://github.com/pgquiles/opencode-muse#installation) for setup and the compatibility fallback.

### Current limitations

Muse approvals and structured questions remain fail-closed; audio/PDF input, strict JSON output, and rewind/fork are unavailable. Pay-as-you-go behavior and live event-gap recovery have not been verified. See [Current limitations](https://github.com/pgquiles/opencode-muse#current-limitations).

Package: [opencode-muse@0.1.0 on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-muse/v/0.1.0)
